description: One page from the inventory with its own title and description, the title and description that are served after meta rules and saved changes, and the source of each served value: a rule pattern, or page for a change saved on this page. Returns page null when the URL is not in the inventory. Changes nothing. Needs a token; a read-only API key is sufficient and recommended.

url.description: The page URL. Its host must be a connected domain.

name: lookup_page
title: Look up page
